text:
marta: Quick sync — final pass on copy for the three landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Need launch-post blurbs, webinar hooks, and inbound routing rules by EOD so growth can build the funnel.

sam: I can do a round for Hosted API. Focus: speed + simple pricing callout. Want a short benchmark line we can use in posts.

eli: For Dedicated, highlight reserved capacity and SLA. Also add a one-liner about predictable unit costs.

ashley: Private page needs compliance-first language, mention VPC + KMS, small example of enterprise onboarding timeline. Keep it <60 chars for hero.

priya: Webinar hook idea — "How to cut per-token cost 3x without sacrificing latency". Use as lead magnet in 2 launch posts.

marta: Love that hook. Can we draft 3 tweet-length variants + one long LinkedIn post? Also need a benchmark sentence for hosted: "99th percentile token latency under Xms on common prompts" — but avoid hard numbers until eng confirms.

sam: Drafts — short variants for Hosted: 1) "Ship generative features with sub-100ms frames — Redwood Hosted API." 2) "Start fast, scale cheaper: Hosted API for production LLMs." 3) "Hosted inference with observability and cost controls."

eli: Dedicated short variants: 1) "Reserved GPU capacity, SLA-backed latency." 2) "Predictable throughput for production models." 3) "Bring your load — we guarantee it."

ashley: Private short variants: 1) "VPC-ready inference with customer-managed keys." 2) "Air-gapped option + audit logs for regulated workloads." 3) "Private deployments, enterprise controls."

priya: LinkedIn long post (draft): "We built Redwood Inference to make serving LLMs predictable. Whether you want instant Hosted APIs, SLA-backed Dedicated fleets, or fully Private deployments — our platform helps engineering teams ship features faster, lower per-token costs, and stay secure. Join our webinar to see real benchmarks and a live rollout walkthrough."

marta: Solid. Can we add one benchmark teaser sentence for LinkedIn: "See a 2–4x improvement in token cost with default caching and batching presets in our tests." (flag: tentative until benchmark doc)

ops-bot: deploy-note: benchmarking job 2026-03-23-01 completed — results pending ingestion.

sam: For the landing CTAs, propose: Hosted -> "Try Hosted API" (free credits), Dedicated -> "Request Dedicated capacity" (contact form), Private -> "Talk to Sales" (enterprise form).

eli: Agree. Add microcopy under Dedicated CTA: "SLA, burst capacity, predictable pricing."

ashley: For Private microcopy: "VPC & on-prem options, KMS, audit logs." Keep it concise.

marta: Inbound routing — here's a working mapping. Can Growth/EngOps implement?

marta: ```
# inbound routing prototype
- if utm_source == "webinar" and page == "private": route -> sales-enterprise (tag: webinar-private)
- if utm_source == "social" and page == "hosted": route -> freemium-nurture (tag: hosted-social)
- if contact_reason includes "dedicated": route -> growth-dedicated (tag: demo-dedicated)
```

priya: Add webinar attendees auto-tag: "webinar-2026-03-30" so we can run a post-webinar nurture.

ops-bot: routing-rule: new rule created draft/id=rdw-20260330-1

sam: Quick A/B for headline wording on Hosted: A) "Production LLMs, no ops" B) "Hosted inference that scales" — prefer A for developer hook?

eli: A resonates with devs. B is more product-y. We can run A on social, B on paid.

ashley: For webinar slide deck — I'll upload a first pass of compliance slides + customer onboarding timeline to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RedwoodWebinarDeck 

marta: Action items: Sam -> Hosted hero variants + one benchmark-safe sentence (by 3pm). Eli -> Dedicated copy + microcopy (by 3pm). Ashley -> Private hero + compliance slide deck (by EOD). Priya -> Draft 2 launch posts + webinar registration page copy (by 4pm). EngOps -> implement inbound routing prototype and confirm webhook ids.

priya: Noted. I'll also prepare two email subject lines: "Reduce inference cost with modern serving" and "See real LLM benchmarks — live webinar"

marta: Thanks team. We'll reconvene at 5pm for final sign-off. :party_parrot:
